Faculty of Life Sciences
Faculty of Life Sciences
©
derknopfdruecker
The Faculty of Life Sciences at the University of Vienna conducts cutting-edge research in biology, pharmacy and nutritional sciences, advancing our understanding of biological systems, evolution, health and disease. Our curiosity-driven fundamental research provides the basis for solutions to global challenges, including climate change, sustainable nutrition, biodiversity loss, novel therapeutics and healthy ageing.
Our outstanding and internationally recognised work has been honoured with top awards and grants. Beyond research and teaching, we drive innovation and societal impact through active knowledge transfer to make science accessible and tangible through hands-on experience and public engagement.
Our areas of responsibility
Research
Research at the Faculty of Life Sciences spans the fields of biology, pharmacy and nutritional sciences.
Studies
19 different study programmes and 3 doctoral schools combine in-depth specialized knowledge with diverse methodologies.
Innovation & Impact
Creating genuine value for society and the environment by fostering innovation, sustainability and hands-on engagement.
About Us
1.140 employees, ~9.200 students, 8 departments, 3 main locations and much more.
